title: McStatsBot
description: Daily Minecraft stats reports delivered straight to your Discord channel. Track playtime, combat, mining, exploration and more — setup takes 2 minutes, no hosting required.
body:
# MCStatsBot

**Daily Minecraft Stats in Discord. Setup in under 2 minutes.**

---

### What it does

Your Minecraft server is already tracking everything — kills, deaths, blocks, playtime, exploration.

MCStatsBot turns that raw data into clean, readable Discord reports your community actually cares about.

Set it up once, pick what you want to see, and get a daily summary in your channel. That's it.

---

### How it works

The plugin collects stats on your server and sends a daily summary to our service, which formats everything and posts it to Discord. Only aggregated statistics are sent — no chat content or sensitive data.

**No config files. No bot tokens. No hosting.**
Just open a link, connect Discord, and you're done.

---

### What you get

- Daily reports at your preferred time
- Choose exactly what to include — Overview, Combat, Mining, Exploration, Fun Facts, and more
- English and German support
- Multiple Minecraft servers per Discord bot
- Lightweight, async design — no TPS impact
- EU-hosted backend (Austria), open source on [GitHub](https://github.com/panie18/MCStatsBot)

---

### Privacy

Data is processed on EU-hosted servers (Austria) to generate reports. Only aggregated gameplay statistics are used. No chat content is stored or shared.

No data is sold or used for tracking. Self-hosting is available for full control.

---

### Compatibility

- Paper, Purpur, Spigot — 1.21.x
- Paper 26.1+ (Tiny Takeover and newer)
- Java 21 or later

---

### Getting started

1. Drop the JAR in `plugins/` and restart
2. Check your server logs — a setup URL will appear on startup
3. Open that URL, sign in with Discord, and pick your channel, language, sections, and report time
4. Set it up once, forget about it, and enjoy your daily reports

---

### Commands

`/mcstats reload` — reloads the config
*Permission: `mcstatsbot.admin`*

---

### Bugs, ideas, help

If something's broken or you want a feature, open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/panie18/MCStatsBot) or leave a reply here. PRs are welcome too.
